# SQL Patterns: mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live

*Auto-generated by ads-kb-datamap (from-code) -- 510 references (15 write, 495 read)*
*Generated on: 2026-06-15*

## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 标准分区过滤 (几乎所有查询)
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- tz_type 选择 (~70% 用 local，余下用 regional)
AND tz_type = 'local'           -- 多数业务分析、incentive 策略
AND tz_type = 'regional'        -- 部分 ROI 分析、全局指标

-- 活跃广告主筛选
AND ads_expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0          -- 近 7 天有消耗
AND is_active_ads_seller = 1                -- 活跃广告主
AND has_active_ads = 1                      -- 有激活广告

-- 地区标准 8 区
AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')

-- 日期范围查询 (多天聚合)
AND grass_date BETWEEN date_add(current_date(), -7) AND date_add(current_date(), -1)
AND grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')

-- 7 天滚动窗口 (LTV 监控, ROI vs category 对比)
AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'

-- 90 天滚动窗口 (traffic boost 特征工程)
AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${ISO_2DAY_AGO}', 89) AND '${ISO_2DAY_AGO}'

-- 有消耗 + 活跃组合过滤 (hit balance 检测)
AND ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d > 0
AND (is_active_ads_seller = 1 OR has_active_ads = 1)

-- paid credit 支出拆分 (用于区分付费/免费信用消耗)
SUM(COALESCE(paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_local_1d, 0.0) + COALESCE(paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_local_1d, 0.0)) AS expense_paid_credit_amt

-- SOD (Start-of-Day) 余额推算
total_eod_balance_td + ads_expenditure_amt_local_1d AS sod_balance
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: 与 ads_advertise_mkt_1d (广告维度表) JOIN → 获取广告主级支出/GMV/余额
-- 最常见: 其他表 LEFT JOIN ads_advertiser_mkt_1d ON shop_id + grass_region + grass_date
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live y
    ON x.grass_region = y.grass_region
    AND x.grass_date = y.grass_date
    AND x.shop_id = y.shop_id
WHERE y.tz_type = 'local'

-- Pattern 2: 与 dws_advertise_performance_nd (广告效果 N 天表) JOIN → 获取广告效果 + 广告主信息
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live b
    ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
    AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id
    AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date

-- Pattern 3: 与 dim_shop_info / dim_advertiser JOIN → 获取卖家分层
-- ads_advertiser_mkt_1d 提供 platform_gmv_usd_30d 用于 seller tier 分档

-- Pattern 4: FULL OUTER JOIN ads_advertiser_mkt_1d + ads_advertiser_seller_all_metrics → wide table (traffic boost)
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT ... FROM ads_advertiser_mkt_1d ...) perf
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT ... FROM ads_advertiser_seller_all_metrics ...) metrics
  ON perf.shop_id = metrics.shop_id
 AND perf.grass_region = metrics.grass_region
 AND perf.grass_date = metrics.grass_date

-- Pattern 5: ads_advertiser_mkt_1d + ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d → 余额 + 预算联合分析 (incentive wide table)
campaign_budget FULL OUTER JOIN advertiser_mkt_tag USING (grass_date, grass_region, shop_id)
FULL OUTER JOIN advertiser_mkt_metric USING (grass_date, grass_region, shop_id)
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Seller Tier 分档 (基于 platform_gmv_usd_30d)
CASE WHEN platform_gmv_usd_30d >= 25000 THEN 'Tier 1: Top Seller'
     WHEN platform_gmv_usd_30d >= 10000 THEN 'Tier 2: Macro Seller'
     WHEN platform_gmv_usd_30d >= 5000  THEN 'Tier 3: Medium Seller'
     WHEN platform_gmv_usd_30d >= 2000  THEN 'Tier 4: Micro Seller'
     ELSE 'Tier 5: Nano Seller'
END AS seller_size

-- 广告主维度聚合 (典型场景)
SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d) AS total_spend
SUM(ads_broad_gmv_usd_1d) AS total_broad_gmv
SUM(ads_order_cnt_1d) AS total_orders
COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS seller_cnt

-- 多天段对比
SUM(IF(grass_date BETWEEN date1 AND date2, ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d, 0)) AS period1_rev
SUM(IF(grass_date BETWEEN date3 AND date4, ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d, 0)) AS period2_rev

-- 品类级别支出聚合 (自引用 → 写入自身的 l1cat/l2cat 字段)
SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) AS l1cat_ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d
SUM(ads_gmv_usd) AS l1cat_ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d
GROUP BY tz_type, grass_region, shop_id, level1_global_be_category

-- Broad order N 天窗口聚合 (自引用)
SUM(CASE WHEN is_7d = 1 THEN broad_order_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_broad_gmv_usd_7d

-- Take rate 计算 (incentive strategy)
ads_expenditure_amt_usd_30d / platform_gmv_usd_30d AS take_rate

-- Hit balance 检测 (incentive engine)
CASE WHEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d >= (ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d + total_eod_balance_usd_td) * 0.90
     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hit_balance

-- 店铺 ROI vs 品类 ROI 差异 (incentive wide table)
SUM(ads_broad_gmv_usd_1d) / SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d)  -- shop ROI
/
SUM(l1cat_ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) / SUM(l1cat_ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d)  -- category ROI
AS shop_roi_vs_cate_diff_l7d
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 广告主活跃判断 + 支出筛选 (incentive eligibility)

```sql
SELECT shop_id, grass_region
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','TH','VN','SG','TW','BR')
  AND ads_expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0
```

### Snippet 2: 多天消耗对比 (月对月)

```sql
SELECT grass_region, shop_id,
    SUM(IF(grass_date BETWEEN date'2026-03-01' AND date'2026-03-30',
        ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d, 0)) AS lp_rev,
    SUM(IF(grass_date BETWEEN date'2026-04-01' AND date'2026-04-30',
        ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d, 0)) AS rev
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','SG','BR','VN','PH','TH','TW','MY')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY grass_region, shop_id
```

### Snippet 3: Seller Tier 分档 JOIN

```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live y
    ON x.grass_region = y.grass_region
    AND x.grass_date = y.grass_date
    AND x.shop_id = y.shop_id
WHERE y.tz_type = 'local'
-- 使用 platform_gmv_usd_30d 做 seller tier 分档
```

### Snippet 4: 品类维度支出聚合 (生产逻辑自引用 ads_advertise_mkt_1d)

```sql
SELECT tz_type, grass_region, shop_id,
    lower(level1_global_be_category.level1_global_be_category) AS level1_global_be_category,
    SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_local) AS l1cat_ads_expenditure_amt_1d,
    SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) AS l1cat_ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d,
    SUM(ads_gmv_local) AS l1cat_ads_gmv_amt_1d,
    SUM(ads_gmv_usd) AS l1cat_ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
```

### Snippet 5: Broad order N 天窗口聚合 (生产逻辑自引用)

```sql
SELECT tz_type, grass_region, shop_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date = '${grass_date}' THEN broad_order_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_broad_gmv_usd_1d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (DATE'${grass_date}' - INTERVAL 6 DAYS)
        AND DATE'${grass_date}' THEN broad_order_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_broad_gmv_usd_7d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (DATE'${grass_date}' - INTERVAL 29 DAYS)
        AND DATE'${grass_date}' THEN broad_order_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_broad_gmv_usd_30d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 6: Checkout 聚合 (生产逻辑自引用)

```sql
SELECT tz_type, grass_region, shop_id,
    SUM(checkout_cnt) AS checkout_cnt
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 7: Traffic Boost 特征工程

```sql
-- 从 ads_advertiser_mkt_1d 提取广告主维度特征用于 ML 模型
SELECT shop_id, grass_region,
    ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d,
    ads_impression_1d, ads_click_cnt_1d,
    total_topup_amt_usd_1d,
    total_eod_balance_usd_td,
    shop_level1_global_be_category,
    is_cb_seller, is_managed_seller
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Snippet 8: Hit Balance 检测 (incentive engine)

```sql
SELECT grass_region, shop_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d >=
        (ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d + total_eod_balance_usd_td) * 0.90
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_hit_balance
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 13) AND DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND (is_active_ads_seller = 1 OR has_active_ads = 1)
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')
  AND ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 9: SOD Balance + Shop Ad Budget Suggestion

```sql
SELECT shop_id, grass_region,
    shop_level1_global_be_category AS l1_cat,
    total_eod_balance_td + ads_expenditure_amt_local_1d AS sod_balance
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${prev2}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')
```

### Snippet 10: Shop ROI vs Category ROI (incentive wide table)

```sql
SELECT grass_region, shop_id,
    SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d) / SUM(ads_broad_gmv_usd_1d) AS shop_roi_7d,
    SUM(l1cat_ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d) / SUM(l1cat_ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) AS cat_roi_7d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('BR','ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 11: LTV Actual Spend Monitoring (7-day rolling)

```sql
SELECT grass_region, shop_id,
    SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d) AS actual_spend_7d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```
